def add_picture_fit(slide, path, x, y, w, h, border=True):
    path = str(path)
    # Add picture to fit within box preserving aspect ratio
    from PIL import Image
    im = Image.open(path)
    iw, ih = im.size
    box_ratio = w / h
    img_ratio = iw / ih
    if img_ratio >= box_ratio:
        width = Inches(w)
        height = Inches(w / img_ratio)
        left = Inches(x)
        top = Inches(y + (h - w / img_ratio)/2)
    else:
        height = Inches(h)
        width = Inches(h * img_ratio)
        left = Inches(x + (w - h * img_ratio)/2)
        top = Inches(y)
    pic = slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top, width=width, height=height)
    if border:
        rect = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
        rect.fill.background()
        line(rect, RGBColor(55, 83, 118), 1.0, 0)
    return pic

def add_picture_fit(slide, path, x, y, w, h, border=True):
    path = str(path)
    # Add picture to fit within box preserving aspect ratio
    from PIL import Image
    im = Image.open(path)
    iw, ih = im.size
    box_ratio = w / h
    img_ratio = iw / ih
    if img_ratio >= box_ratio:
        width = Inches(w)
        height = Inches(w / img_ratio)
        left = Inches(x)
        top = Inches(y + (h - w / img_ratio)/2)
    else:
        height = Inches(h)
        width = Inches(h * img_ratio)
        left = Inches(x + (w - h * img_ratio)/2)
        top = Inches(y)
    pic = slide.shapes.add_picture(path, left, top, width=width, height=height)
    if border:
        rect = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
        rect.fill.background()
        line(rect, RGBColor(55, 83, 118), 1.0, 0)
    return pic
